tool_config.name: prepare_bank_send
tool_config.description: Send money to a bank account: a saved one ("my landlord's bank account": pass payee) or a bank and account number. Plus reads back the account name; she confirms like any payment (a Yes, or her PIN on the screen above ₦5,000). It goes through the partner bank (simulated).

payee.description: A saved bank account by her name for it ("landlord"). Leave out when she gives a number.

bank.description: The bank, as she says it ("Ironwood"). The tool lists the banks if it doesn't know it.
